source: Transcribed from the Rigol DL3000 Series Programmable DC Electronic Load Programming Guide, covering the DL3021/DL3021A/DL3031/DL3031A. Eighteen entries — the IEEE 488.2 chapter, LXI:RESet and :[SOURce]:CURRent:TRANsient:ALEVel — were read off the guide by eye because their two columns are out of step and pairing text with the label level with it produces confident nonsense; the parser refuses those rather than guessing. Everything else is machine-transcribed, and all 79 commands in the guide's Command List tables are present.
